title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen Coker (ankle) works on side with trainer Thursday
items.desc: Jalen Coker was seen working on the side with the trainer on Thursday.
items.impact: Coker was listed as limited in practice on Wednesday. He'll need to be monitored again in practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) 'ready to go' for Week 2
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) told reporters that he is "ready to go" ahead of Sunday's matchup against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: It looks like Henderson is finally healthy after missing the season opener due to an ankle injury. He was able to log a full practice on Wednesday and told reporters that he is "ready to go" on Thursday, which puts him squarely on track to play this week. His likely presence will mean less work for Rhamondre Stevenson moving forward, though it will benefit the offense as a whole.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: A.J. Terrell Jr. (shoulder) practices Thursday
items.desc: A.J. Terrell Jr. returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Terrell did not practice to begin the week on Wednesday. His return on Thursday should give him a chance to be good to go for Week 2.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: EJ WIlliams signs with Panthers' practice squad
items.desc: EJ WIlliams signed a deal to join Carolina's practice squad.
items.impact: The Panthers are signing Williams to their practice squad after opening up a spot with the promotion of linebacker Tyrel Dodson to their active roster. The rookie is not expected to play a prominent role for Carolina anytime soon, but he may compete and earn a roster spot if he performs well as a member of their practice squad.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Lindstrom (concussion) practices Thursday
items.desc: Chris Lindstrom returned to practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Lindstrom remains in the concussion protocol. He'll have to clear it by Saturday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. (knee) seen throwing with starters Thursday
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. (knee) and Cooper Rush (back) were both seen throwing with Atlanta's starters on Thursday.
items.impact: It's still uncertain whether or not Penix will be active in Week 2, but he was seen throwing to the team's starters on Thursday along with Cooper Rush (back), which indicates that he still very much has a chance to suit up. Fantasy managers should pay close attention to this QB situation throughout the rest of the week to see who will be the starter against the Panthers this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cooper Rush (back) practicing with starters Thursday
items.desc: Cooper Rush (back) and Michael Penix Jr. (knee) were both throwing passes with Atlanta's starters on Thursday.
items.impact: Rush was the starter for Atlanta in Week 1, and with Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) still not practicing, it looks like the starting nod in Week 2 will be between him and Michael Penix Jr. (knee). They were both practicing with the starters on Thursday, so it seems like the team has yet to make a decision on who will be at the helm for them against the Panthers this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Alec Pierce (heel) not seen practicing Thursday
items.desc: Alec Pierce was not seen practicing on Thursday.
items.impact: Pierce practiced in full on Wednesday. This will be something to monitor in practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joe Burrow (back) participating at practice Thursday
items.desc: Joe Burrow (back) was seen participating at practice on Thursday after not throwing passes at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Burrow wasn't throwing passes at practice on Wednesday due to some back soreness that he was dealing with, but he is in pads and throwing passes at the start of Cincinnati's practice on Thursday. That's a good sign that he will be close to full health for Week 2, but we won't know more for sure until the team's official injury report comes out sometime after practice.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) not spotted at practice Thursday
items.desc: Tua Tagovailoa (oblique) was not spotted at Atlanta's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Tagovailoa is trending towards missing Sunday's game against the Panthers. He wasn't able to practice on Wednesday, and now it looks like he's missing another practice on Thursday, as he wasn't spotted by reporters at practice. If he's sidelined again, Cooper Rush (back) seems like the most likely candidate to start in his absence, which would be bad news for all of Atlanta's fantasy options in this matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) was not seen at Washington's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Okonkwo was not spotted during the early portions of Thursday's practice, meaning he is more than likely going to be a non-participant on their injury report. That puts him on track to miss Sunday's game against the Cowboys, which would lead to more work for John Bates in that matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jimmy Horn Jr. expected to sign with Browns
items.desc: Jimmy Horn Jr. is expected to sign a deal to join the Cleveland Browns.
items.impact: Horn is expected to land a deal with the Browns after being cut by the Panthers earlier this week. He isn't expected to have any fantasy relevance on this subpar offense for the foreseeable future, but he could mix in the rotation and play a real role for this team throughout the course of the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Darnell Washington (personal) not spotted at practice Thursday
items.desc: Darnell Washington (personal) was not spotted at Pittsburgh's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Washington is tending to a personal issue of some kind right now, which caused him to miss Wednesday's practice. It looks like he may be missing another practice on Thursday, and it's unclear whether or not this will affect his availability for Week 2. Either way, he remains off of the fantasy radar at this point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Troy Fautanu (ankle) to be limited Thursday
items.desc: Troy Fautanu (ankle) will be a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The young lineman is going to be a limited participant during Thursday's practice according to HC Mike McCarthy. It looks Fautanu is trending towards playing in Week 2, which is good news for the Steelers ahead of a tough matchup against the Patriots on the road.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) was not seen at Baltimore's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout was officially limited at practice on Wednesday, but he wasn't spotted during the open portion of practice on Thursday, which is an indicator that he may be a non-participant. That wouldn't bode well for his Week 2 availability and could indicate that Pat Freiermuth will be in for a bigger role this week if Pittman is limited or sidelined against the Patriots.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trey Hendrickson (finger) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Trey Hendrickson (finger) is absent from Baltimore's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Hendrickson was not spotted during Baltimore's practice at all on Thursday, which likely means that he will once again be a non-participant. He could be sidelined in Week 2, which would be bad news for New Orleans' defense ahead of a matchup against his former team, the Saints, who seemed to have a potent offense in the season opener last week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) not seen at practice Wednesday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) was not seen at practice for the Ravens on Wednesday.
items.impact: Simpson appears to be absent from Baltimore's second practice of the week on Wednesday, which isn't good news for his availability for Week 2. He may very well be sidelined this week, which isn't good news for the Ravens' offense as a whole.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (toe) not spotted at practice Thursday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley (toe) was not spotted at Baltimore's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, it looks like Stanley is missing another practice on Thursday after missing Wednesday's practice due to a toe issue of some kind. John Simpson (groin) is also battling an injury right now, and it looks like Baltimore's offensive line may be weaker than usual in their matchup against the Saints in Week 2.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) not seen at practice Thursday
items.desc: Zay Flowers (hamstring) was not seen at Baltimore's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Flowers is missing another practice session on Thursday, as he was not spotted during the portion open to the media. We will know his status for sure later on in the day, but this doesn't bode well for his availability for Sunday's game against the Saints. Rashod Bateman and Devontez Walker will both benefit from his absence if he's out for that matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Israel Abanikanda signing with Cowboys' practice squad
items.desc: Israel Abanikanda is signing a deal to join the Cowboys as a member of their practice squad.
items.impact: The Cowboys recently released Abanikanda, but they are bringing him back and giving him a spot on their practice squad. He isn't expected to be a consistent contributor for them moving forward, however, especially now that Tyler Goodson is a part of their active roster.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bryce Oliver signs with Texans' practice squad
items.desc: Bryce Oliver is signing a deal to join the Texans' practice squad.
items.impact: Oliver was recently released by the Browns, but he will find a new opportunity in Houston with the Texans' practice squad. He is unlikely to make an impact at any point this season, however, so he remains irrelevant for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mark Gronowski released by Texans
items.desc: Mark Gronowski has been released from Houston's practice squad.
items.impact: The Texans signed Gronowski to their practice squad just over a week ago, but they are now releasing him and he will once again be on the open market. Houston currently has only two healthy QB's on their roster, with Graham Mertz set to miss the entire season with a torn ACL.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nico Collins diagnosed with Grade 1 hamstring strain
items.desc: Nico Collins was diagnosed with a Grade 1 hamstring injury and was not seen at Houston's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Collins is officially being diagnosed with a Grade 1 hamstring injury after undergoing tests on it. That is a relatively minor injury, which is good news, but he still may miss 1-3 games because of it, which is further confirmed by his apparent absence from practice on Thursday. Fantasy managers should look for Kayshon Boutte, Dalton Schultz, and Jaylin Noel to see more work in Week 2 if the Texans are without their top wideout against the Bengals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Max Melton (ankle) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Max Melton (ankle) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Cardinals could be down one of their starting quarterbacks this week, as Melton is dealing with an ankle injury of some kind that left him limited at practice on Wednesday. His absence would be less than ideal ahead of a tough matchup against Jaxson Smith-Njigba and Co. this weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) off injury report for Week 2
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is off of Arizona's injury report ahead of their Week 2 matchup against the Seattle Seahawks.
items.impact: The rookie running back was dealing with an ankle injury prior to the team's season opener last week, but he was able to play through it against the Chargers and should be able to do the same in Week 2 now that he's off of the injury report entirely. His workload should continue to ramp up in the coming weeks if he can stay healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trey McBride (rest/back) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Trey McBride (rest/back) did not take part in Arizona's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Arizona gave their star tight end the day off on Wednesday as a rest day. He was also listed with a back issue of some kind, but it seems to be nothing serious and isn't likely to play a factor on his availability for Week 2. He will remain a top-tier fantasy asset every time he's healthy and on the field for the Cardinals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ty Okada (hamstring) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ty Okada did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Okada missed the season opener last week. He remains uncertain for Week 2 on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cooper Kupp (back) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Cooper Kupp was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Kupp will likely be limited in practice on most Wednesday's. He remains off the fantasy radar.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jones (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Josh Jones was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jones was also on the injury report last week with a knee issue. He should be good to go in his depth role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jobe (wrist) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Josh Jobe was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jobe is on the injury report with a wrist issue. He should be good to go to on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tory Horton (hamstring) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Tory Horton was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: It is a positive sign for Horton to be able to make his season debut on Sunday against the Cardinals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Emmanwori (ankle/hip) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Nick Emmanwori was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Emmanwori was also limited in practice last week. He could make his season debut on Sunday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Bradford (knee) limited in practice Wednesday
items.desc: Anthony Bradford was limited in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bradford remains on track to be good to go for Week 2 on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lukas Van Ness (concussion) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Lukas Van Ness (concussion) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Packers' edge rusher is currently going through the NFL's concussion protocols and was limited on Wednesday as a result. Their defensive front will be weaker than usual if he is unable to suit up and play against the Jets this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zach Bako-Bewele (knee) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Zach Bako-Bewele (knee) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Packers' starting right tackle is a new addition to their injury report. He's dealing with a knee injury right now, but it remains unclear whether or not it will threaten his availability for Week 2. Aaron Banks (knee) is also injured right now, so the Packers' offensive line may struggle this week if they are missing multiple of their starters against the Jets.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Banks (knee) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Aaron Banks (knee) was officially a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was unable to play in the team's season opener last week, but he practiced in a limited fashion on Wednesday and seems to have a chance to suit up in Week 2. Green Bay's offense would benefit greatly from the return of one of their starting offensive linemen.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Juszczyk (finger) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Kyle Juszczyk (finger) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Juszczyk has been dealing with this finger injury for a little while already and was limited at another practice on Wednesday. He was able to play through it last week and will likely do the same in Week 2, which is good news for San Francisco's offense as a whole.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Eddy Pineiro (illness) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Eddy Pineiro (illness) was absent from San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran kicker missed the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday due to an illness that he's currently recovering from. He should be ready to play in time for Week 2, however, and remains a quality fantasy option at the kicker position for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: George Kittle (Achilles) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: George Kittle (Achilles) was limited at San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: San Francisco is still being careful with Kittle's workload at this point, so they left him as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday. He should be able to play on Sunday barring any unforeseen setbacks, however, and will likely continue to ramp up his workload over the next few weeks.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dre Greenlaw (rest/Achilles) sidelined at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Dre Greenlaw (rest/Achilles) was sidelined at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: San Francisco gave several veterans the day off on Wednesday, including Greenlaw, who is still nursing an Achilles injury. He should be good to go for Week 2, which is good news for San Francisco's defense heading into a favorable matchup against the Dolphins.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian McCaffrey (rest) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey (rest) did not take part in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: McCaffrey was a non-participant at San Francisco's practice on Wednesday. The team gave him a routine rest day and he should be back on Thursday, so fantasy managers should have no concerns about him heading into a great Week 2 matchup against the Dolphins.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Bosa (rest/knee) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Nick Bosa (rest/knee) missed San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The star edge rusher was held out of Wednesday's practice as part of the planned injury maintenance for his knee. He should be good to go for Week 2 and will remain one of San Francisco's most impactful players moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chop Robinson (concussion) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Chop Robinson (concussion) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran edge rusher is currently in the NFL's concussion protocols and was only able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday as a result. It looks like he will have a good chance to play in Week 2 still, but we won't know until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) without injury designation for Week 2
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell (hamstring) is without an injury designation heading into Week 2.
items.impact: Mitchell was previously battling a hamstring injury, but he was able to play through it in Week 1 and is now off of the injury report entirely heading into Week 2. He should be a full go moving forward but won't have any real fantasy value on this offense for as long as Omarion Hampton remains healthy for the Chargers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) logs full practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jeanty seems to be entirely over his ankle injury at this point, as he played through it in Week 1 and now logs a full practice session to start the week on Wednesday. He should be a full go and high-quality fantasy option moving forward, assuming he suffers no setbacks with his recovery.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonathan Greenard (pec) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Jonathan Greenard (pec) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was sidelined due to his pectoral injury in Week 1, but he was able to practice on Wednesday and seems to have a chance to make his return to the lineup in Week 2. Philadelphia's pass rush will get an upgrade whenever he's back in their lineup and fully healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cooper DeJean (calf/abdomen) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Cooper DeJean (calf/abdomen) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: DeJean pops up on the injury report to start the week due to a pair of injuries that he is battling. He wasn't able to practice at all on Wednesday, which puts his availability for Week 2 in question. Philadelphia has multiple key defenders on the injury report right now, so their defense could be weaker than usual in a matchup against the Titans this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Carter (wrist) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jalen Carter (wrist) did not take part in Philadelphia's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The star defensive tackle wasn't able to take part in practice on Wednesday. He's dealing with a wrist injury right now, and it's possible that it will threaten his availability for Week 2. Philadelphia's defensive front will be weaker than usual if he is ruled out for this matchup against the Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dalton Schultz (rest) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz (rest) missed Houston's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end was given Wednesday off as a veteran rest day to start the week. He is likely to be back at practice on Thursday and should play in Week 2, barring anything unforeseen between now and then. He remains a fringe streaming option at the tight end position at this point.
